Name: Alternate Bouquets
Author: Jewelsome
Description:
I am a huge fan of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url] and I wanted to be able to give yellow roses (symbolizes friendships) to my spouse. This mod ONLY changes the look of the in game bouquet but you are free to choose whatever color roses you wish for your gifting purposes. This also changes the description of the bouquet to be more inclusive to different kinds of relationships.


[size=4][u]How to Install[/u][/size]

[size=2]Download the mod file and unzip the folder into your "Mods" folder. [/size]

[u]How to Use[/u]

There are two ways to configure the bouquet color:

[list]
[*]Download the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and change the color from the title screen. 
[*]Open the "config" file in the Alternate Bouquets folder and manually write the color you want your bouquet to be.
[/list]
